SELECT obj."id" AS id, obj."streamId" AS stream_id, obj."data" ->> 'units' AS units, obj."data" ->> 'category' AS category, -- obj."data" ->> 'family' AS family, COALESCE(obj."data" ->> 'family', obj."data" ->> 'category' || '-family') AS family , obj."data" ->> 'type' AS type, obj."data" ->> 'elementId' AS elementId, obj."data" ->> 'parameters' AS parameters FROM objects obj WHERE obj."id" IN ( SELECT jsonb_object_keys ( obj."data" -> '__closure' ) FROM objects obj WHERE obj."id" = ( SELECT info -> 'commit' ->> 'objectId' AS objectId FROM stream_activity WHERE "resourceId" = #{resourceId} AND "actionType" = 'commit_create' ) ) AND obj."data" ->> 'category' IS NOT NULL -- AND obj."data" ->> 'family' IS NOT NULL AND obj."data" ->> 'type' IS NOT NULL AND obj."data" ->> 'elementId' IS NOT NULL
AND obj."data" ->> 'category' = #{category}
SELECT id, "streamId" as streamId, data as parameters FROM "objects" WHERE "id" = #{id} AND "streamId" = #{streamId}
